title: useOptimistic: show the result before the server

slides.say: Use optimistic shows the expected result right away, while the request is still running.
Pass the real value. Inside the Action, set the optimistic value, then await the server.
Render the optimistic name. It shows the new name immediately.

slides.text: When the update finishes or fails, React switches back to the real value.
slides.say: When the update finishes or errors, React automatically switches back to the real current name.
